cases.fixture: C1 explicit precision case: consumer maximum voltage delta string with 30 decimal places (28 significant digits) just above 0.001 ('0.001000000000000000000000000001') labelled EXCEEDS_LIMITS by the consumer
cases.expected: GDecision INCOMPLETE. The string has 30 decimal places (28 significant digits), beyond the 28-place scale of .NET decimal: TryParse either rounds it to 0.001 (parent label WITHIN != consumer EXCEEDS -> disagreement) or fails; both paths are INCOMPLETE (fail-closed), never WITHIN. This documents the disagreement principle, not a precision guarantee; it is not an exact-equality case (that is PY01-02 / PS01-04) and its actual path must be confirmed on the target engine.

Harness: written only after separate authorization; its SHA-256, the extraction offsets of each production function taken from the sealed bytes, and every input file with its expected reason are fixed and shown to the user before the first test.

Engines: python.exe (CONTRACT.python hash), powershell.exe 5.1 (the hash in PARENT_COMMAND.ps1) and the Java helper compiler / JVM (candidates of the accepted normal-30 s COMMANDS.json) are identified before the first test; no other engine.

Final counts: 62 unique IDs (Python 39 + Java helper 2 + PowerShell 21) and 77 inputs; an ID is one plan entry, an input is one engine evaluation inside the single session of its engine (sessions are not per input).
